en.answer:
Since the activation condition of『this card destroying a monster by battle』was still met, the effect will still be activated. When it resolves, it will inflict 1600 damage, which is <<5234>>' original ATK.

The same also applies to the following cards' effects, which can/will still be activated even if the destroyed monster was originally a Trap Card (that was Special Summoned as a monster), and will inflict damage equal to that monster's original ATK respectively DEF: <<8729>>, <<12155>>, <<13745>>, <<16224>>, <<17268>>, and <<17443>>.
en.question: If <<12080>> destroys an opponent's <<5234>> treated as a monster by battle, will its『inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK』effect activate?
en.title: If <<12080>> destroys an opponent's <<5234>> treated as a monster by battle, will its effect that inflicts damage still activate?

ja.answer:
条件である『このカードが戦闘でモンスターを破壊した』が満たされているため、効果は発動します。その処理時には、「<<5234>>」の元々の攻撃力分である1600のダメージを相手に与えます。

以下のカードの効果についても同様に、モンスターとして特殊召喚されている罠カードを戦闘で破壊した場合でも効果を発動でき、その元々の攻撃力や守備力に基づいたダメージを与えることができます。
